plan.notes: Source: official John Jay College 'COMPUTER SCIENCE & INFORMATION SECURITY FOUR YEAR ADVISEMENT PLAN' (Academic Advisement Center, revised 12/13/24), https://www.jjay.cuny.edu/sites/default/files/2025-03/COMP_SCIENCE.pdf, linked from the official 2024-2025 Undergraduate Bulletin page for the Computer Science and Information Security, Bachelor of Science (https://jjay.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/undergraduate-bulletin/majors/computer-science-and-information-security-bachelor-of-science/). Transcription method: manual transcription of the PDF's eight semester-by-semester term grids (Semester 1-8); course titles verified against the 2024-2025 bulletin major page (CSCI 271 Introduction to Computing and Programming; CSCI 272 Object-Oriented Programming; CSCI 274 Computer Architecture; CSCI 360 Cryptography and Cryptanalysis; CSCI 373 Advanced Data Structures; CSCI 374 Programming Languages; CSCI 375 Operating Systems; CSCI 377 Computer Algorithms; CSCI 379 Computer Networking; CSCI 400/401 Capstone Experience in Digital Forensics/Cybersecurity I/II; CSCI 411 Computer Security and Forensics; CSCI 412 Network Security & Forensics; PHI 216 Ethics and Information Technology; MAT 141 Pre-Calculus; MAT 151 Calculus I; MAT 301 Probability & Mathematical Statistics I), the 2023-2024 bulletin course page (MAT 204 Discrete Structures, 3 cr), and the 2020-2021 bulletin General Education Requirements page (ENG 101 Composition I; ENG 201 Composition II; MAT 105 College Algebra). Credit discrepancy: the plan's printed term totals sum to 121 credits (15+15+16+15+15+15+15+15) while the bulletin degree minimum is 120; total_credits uses the sequence's own published total (121) per the Clarkson/UVM/GCSU precedent. Gen-ed slot codes (JUS100C, USXPF, CREX, WCGI, LFPCO, LPSC, ADDFC, INDSOC, COMMCO, JUS300C, ELEC1-ELEC7) are placeholders for student-choice areas, marked choice:true; the plan's 'Elective or Minor' slots are general electives with distinct placeholder codes. Part Three Category A (computer science elective) and Category B (mathematics elective) option lists are transcribed verbatim from the 2024-2025 bulletin Part Three; a 4-credit Category B choice (MAT 152 or MAT 253) raises the term total. Prereqs: ENG 101 is a College prerequisite for all 200-level courses and ENG 201 for all 300/400-level courses, with ENG 101 required before ENG 201 (2020-2021 bulletin, General Education Requirements). CSCI 272 is a prerequisite for all CSCI 300-level courses; CSCI 360, CSCI 373, CSCI 375, CSCI 379 are prerequisites for CSCI 400; CSCI 400, PHI 216, CSCI 377 are prerequisites for CSCI 401 (official Department of Mathematics and Computer Science course flowchart, 'as of Fall 2025', https://www.jjay.cuny.edu/sites/default/files/2025-09/math%26computer%20sci_courseflowchart_fall2025_vert.pdf). Math placement: the CSCI major requires MAT 105 or 141 or higher to begin major courses; as of Fall 2021 MAT 151 replaces MAT 241 (per plan major note). Caveat: the 2025-2026 bulletin exists but this advisement plan (revised 12/13/24) is the official sequence linked from the 2024-2025 bulletin; catalog_year reflects the plan's source year.
